editorialPrinciple: All 83 current unresolved art opportunities are triaged, but none obliges a unique painting. Complete Biblical Theatre narrative remains independent of image approval.
integrityLocks: Stay on existing GitHub research PR; no merges
Zero modifications to selected 101 or to Bib Theatre canonical IDs
Do not claim institutional source identification equals pixel inspection or rights clearance
Act 10 conversion is distinct from Cornelius prostration, and John 21 catch distinct from Matthew 14 water walking
Owner of final images remains human curator; no implied acceptance
